basalt-deep.purpose: Input wells and result strips, one step below the ground.

shale.purpose: Every raised panel: cards, verifier, forms, metric tiles.

shale-raised.purpose: Card hover step; depth comes from this ladder, not from shadows.

slate.purpose: Default hairline: dividers, card borders, table rules.

slate-light.purpose: Interactive hairline: input borders, ghost pill, orbit rings, card hover.

bone.purpose: Body text on dark; ink on lime surfaces.

mist.purpose: Emphasized panel text, legal prose, the serif italic.

ash.purpose: Secondary text, nav links, form labels, hero lead.

ash-soft.purpose: Tertiary text: panel body, metric labels, muted notes, footer.

signal-lime.purpose: The only accent: live status, primary action, links, wordmark, orbit core.

lime-deep.purpose: Hover and pressed step of the primary button.

orbit-blue.purpose: Per-bot accent injected as --accent inside a product card only.

error-surface.purpose: Background of form-error and auth-failure alerts.

error-text.purpose: Error copy and the fail state of a status line.

display.purpose: Landing hero only; hard-broken lines at 780 weight.

headline.purpose: Section headings, dashboard h1, legal h1.

lead.purpose: Paragraph under a display or headline; legal body copy at 66ch.

small.purpose: Nav links, form labels, muted notes, table cells.

meta.purpose: Table headers and footer fine print.

accent.purpose: One italic phrase inside a display or headline; never body or UI.

motion.name: orbit-a
motion.purpose: Outer ellipse ring of the hero orbit; the one authored motion.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions (160ms fast, 280ms for cards).

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Section head, lookup, metric and verifier grids collapse to one column; the lookup form stacks.

breakpoints.name: mobile
breakpoints.purpose: Gutters drop to 1.25rem, section rhythm to 3.5rem, nav text links hide, orbit shrinks and moves above the copy.

themes.mechanism: data-theme attribute on <html>, resolved pre-paint from localStorage then prefers-color-scheme

narrative.overview:
A dark olive ground with lime growing out of it. The surface sits in near black (#10120f) and the only thing that comes up through it is one chartreuse green, used as growth: the accent on a live status, the fill of the one action that matters, a link, the "Eclipse" syllable. Nothing else is colored. Everything else is a step of the same dark, separated by hairlines instead of shadows.

The voice is big and tight. Display type runs to 6rem with tracking pulled to -0.04em and line-height under 0.96, so a headline reads as mass rather than as a line of words, and one Instrument Serif italic phrase is set inside it to break the grotesk — "More capable.", "feel like yours." That pairing is the whole typographic idea: hard geometry, one soft interruption, self-hosted so it actually renders.

Density is low and calm. Sections get 5.5rem of air, panels are 20px-rounded slabs one step lighter than the ground, and no surface casts a shadow. The composition is structural and restrained: hairline borders and tonal layering carry the shape, and the lime stays reserved for signal.
keyCharacteristics: One hue in play — Signal Lime on a Basalt ground — with no second accent.
Display type as mass: 780 weight, -0.04em tracking, 0.96 line-height, 6rem cap.
Two-tone type pairing: Inter Variable plus one Instrument Serif italic phrase.
Flat surfaces, hairline borders, zero shadow anywhere.
Generous vertical rhythm (5.5rem sections) against tight horizontal grids.
No kicker labels: a heading carries its own weight, with no small label above it.
Two themes from one token block (Night Orchard / Day Orchard), two locales (EN / ID), no third variant.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Lime covers at most ~10% of any viewport, and only ever as text, a hairline-adjacent fill, or the single primary button. It never becomes a section background.

rules.name: The Own Hue Rule
rules.body: A bot's accent color is read from data (--accent) inside its own card. Never hard-code a bot hue into the stylesheet, and never let it escape the card.

rules.name: The Text Tint Rule
rules.body: Every text tone on the dark ladder clears 4.5:1 against its own background (Ash Soft on Shale is 6.8:1). No gray is borrowed from outside the palette to make text quiet; use a lower step of the same olive.

rules.name: The Tight Display Rule
rules.body: Type at 2.25rem or larger gets tracking between -0.03em and -0.04em and a line-height at or below 1.05. Display type with neutral tracking is off-system.

rules.name: The One Italic Rule
rules.body: Instrument Serif italic appears at most once per composition, inside a display or headline. Never in body copy, a label, a button, or a table.

rules.name: The Ramp Rule
rules.body: Twelve sizes exist and nothing sits between them: 0.72, 0.8, 0.9, 1, 1.05, 1.35, 1.5, 1.75, 2.25, 3, 4.5, 6rem. A fluid clamp may only interpolate between two of those steps.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are separated by a 1px border, never by a shadow. If a panel needs to feel closer, raise its tone one step toward Shale Raised rather than adding blur.

dos: Do keep every surface on the Basalt → Shale → Shale Raised ladder, and state edges with a 1px Slate hairline.
Do reserve Signal Lime for live status, the primary action, links, and the "Eclipse" syllable.
Do keep display type at 780 weight with -0.03em to -0.04em tracking and a line-height at or below 1.05.
Do break a headline with exactly one Instrument Serif italic phrase when the composition has a hero or CTA.
Do read a bot's accent from --accent data inside its card.
Do theme the browser's own surfaces: lime selection, lime caret, thin scrollbar in Slate Light that turns lime on hover, 3px underline offset, and tabular numerals on every figure and date.
Do give every interactive element hover, focus-visible, active, and disabled states before shipping it.
Do let a heading carry its own weight, and start the section with the heading.
Do show the product's real output (a role, a verdict, a slash command) instead of an abstract ornament that asserts quality.
Do keep every colour in the token block: two themes ship, and a component that looks wrong in one of them is a missing token.
donts: Don't introduce a third theme or a light surface outside the Day Orchard ladder.
Don't fill a section or card with Signal Lime; it is a signal, not a surface.
Don't put a kicker, eyebrow, or small label above a heading.
Don't add a second sans-serif, a third decorative hue, or a serif anywhere outside the one italic phrase.
Don't add a shadow to anything — there is no glow left in the system, and depth is a tone step plus a hairline.
Don't use rounded-full on panels or 0-radius on actions; pills are for actions and circles, 16–22px is for containers.
Don't invent a size between the twelve ramp steps, or a color outside the token block.
